I couldn't find a link to the new travel policy, and I've told Hollis that in a reply to his DM.

I searched the workspace knowledge base and read the channels he's in: #general, #help-it-ops, #central-team and #central-random. I also looked through the shared files he can see. None of them mention a travel policy. I didn't check the #inc-tansley-carrier-api incident channel, though he's a member, because it seemed unlikely to have a policy link. I also didn't use the company-wide message search, since it would show him conversations he isn't part of.

In the reply I suggested he ask HR or whoever announced the policy, and I offered to look in a specific place if he remembers where it was posted.
